summary: Frontend-only regression after removing 'Nuovo Rumor' feature and fixing the 'checkResult is not defined' profile crash. All 7 requested scenarios verified end-to-end with 0 page errors and 0 runtime exceptions. Player profile (p-lookman) AND Coach profile (c-gilardino) both open cleanly with Cronologia + Carriera tabs rendering. Dashboard TOP NEWS shows CALDISSIME ORA hot cards and ULTIME NOTIZIE feed. News page (nav-radar) exposes news-search-input which filters cards (7→0 for non-matching query), each card has a green verify-source-* button whose href AND visible label are a https://news.google.com/... URL. NO 'Simulate Scan' button anywhere. Investigate + Dismiss buttons on 'New' alerts work (Dismiss removes the card). Sidebar has NO nav-add-rumor; nav-radar has permanent nav-live-dot (red pulse) + 'Live' badge. Profile header exposes transfer-card-btn + export-draft-btn only (no add-rumor). TransferCardDialog opens with transfer-card-download + transfer-card-copy buttons. Article Draft dialog opens correctly. Streak Lab: streak-google-login gateway → mock spinner → arena; both vote-yes and vote-no rotate challenge-question to a new question (verified 3 distinct questions across gate→vote SI→vote NO). Source Guarantee banner (scoop-guarantee) + SCOOP badge visible on Lookman timeline.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js: verified no leftover `checkResult`/`onAddRumor` props are passed to ProfileView. Grep across /app/frontend/src for 'checkResult', 'onAddRumor', 'nav-add-rumor', 'add-rumor', 'radar-scan' returns zero matches — clean removal.
ProfileView.jsx now cleanly renders header with only transfer-card-btn + export-draft-btn, tabs cronologia/carriera, and aside ContractCard. No dead code.
Sidebar.jsx: nav-add-rumor removed. nav-live-dot is rendered permanently on nav-radar via the `dot` prop regardless of alertsCount — matches spec.

RadarFeed.jsx: no `radar-scan-btn` code path remains; feed has search + investigate/dismiss actions only. Green verify-source button correctly shows the google news URL as visible text (font-mono, truncated).
Minor optional polish: verify-source button uses `truncate` on the URL text — on very narrow screens the URL is elided but this is by design and the full href is on the anchor's title tooltip.
TransferCardDialog + ArticleDraftDialog are custom (not role='dialog'); use data-testid selectors for automation (already documented).
test_credentials: N/A — client-side mock auth via localStorage.setItem('mt_authed','1') or Google button on LoginScreen.

rca of the issue: The original crash was caused by leftover JSX references to `checkResult` and `onAddRumor` props (used by the removed New Rumor dialog) inside ProfileView. Main agent removed them and now App.js renders <ProfileView profile={selectedProfile} rumors={rumors} /> without those props. Regression suite confirms no ReferenceError occurs anymore.
